title: slicer list: explain the ! dependency marker in its output
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the `^` score marker, the TUI queue, the agent text in `src/slicer/ai.py` (s339 covered it), `deps` (its rows never carry `!`), and any JSON shape.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `slicer list` and `slicer find` mark a row with `!` after the row number when the item waits on a dependency not yet met. Today's main shows `17! s382 ... Relay hand-back while a role runs`, which waits on s385. Nothing on screen says what the mark means. Only `docs/commands.md` (near lines 266 and 856) explains it, and since s339 the agent text does too (`src/slicer/ai.py:79`). A person reading the list has to know the docs or run `show` on each marked row. The fix is a legend line that appears only when a printed row carries the mark, so a list with no marked rows doesn't change.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`:
  - `_item_rows` (near line 1839) sets the mark from `graph.pending` (`src/slicer/graph.py:105`), which returns the unmet ids.
  - `cmd_list` (near line 1911) builds the lines and the `N items hidden` footer (near line 1979).
  - `_emit_find` (near line 2091) prints `find`'s rows.
  - Add one helper that builds the legend from `graph.pending` for the printed items, and call it from both commands.
- `tests/test_cli.py`, next to `test_List_Text_BlockedRow_MarkedWithBang` (near line 912), reusing that class's `repo()` fixture (S01 waits on S02).
- `docs/commands.md` (the `list` paragraph near line 266 and the example near line 856).
- `CHANGELOG.md` under Changed.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_List_Text_BlockedRow_EndsWithLegend`: with S01 waiting on S02, the text output has the line `! waits on a dependency not yet met: S01 (S02)` once, after the last row.
- `test_List_Text_NoBlockedRow_NoLegend`: once S02 is done, no line starts with `! `.
- `test_List_Text_Legend_BeforeHiddenCount`: with a done item hidden, the legend comes directly before the `N item hidden` line.
- `test_List_Text_Legend_SeveralBlocked_InRowOrder`: two marked rows with two unmet dependencies on one of them read `! waits on a dependency not yet met: S01 (S02, S04), S03 (S02)`, in printed row order with each item's unmet ids in `depends_on` order.
- `test_Find_Text_BlockedRow_EndsWithLegend`: `find waiting` ends with the same legend line, after the last `matched in` line.
- `test_List_Json_Unchanged_ByBlockedMarker` and `test_Find_...` JSON stay green; `--json` output carries no legend.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Add the helper and append its line in `cmd_list` (before the hidden count and the sibling-only block) and in `_emit_find`. Print nothing when no printed row is pending.
3. Update `docs/commands.md` and CHANGELOG.
4. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
